{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Over 30,000 Americans demonstrated their commitment to reasserting government of, by, and for the people by attending 1645 local platform hearings.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Millions of Americans demonstrated their commitment to reasserting government of, by, and for the people by turning out in primaries and caucuses.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A record-breaking number of Americans abroad participated in the political process, including members of the military.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats want to continue the momentum of the election.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Only by continuing the momentum of the election can Democrats bring the change necessary to restore the promise of America.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In Barack Obama's Administration, the administration will open up the doors of democracy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"In Barack Obama's Administration, the administration will use technology to make government more transparent, accountable, and inclusive.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"In Barack Obama's Administration, the administration will require agencies to conduct significant business in public and release all relevant information unless an agency reasonably foresees harm to a protected interest.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"In Barack Obama's Administration, the administration will lift the veil of secret deals in Washington by publishing searchable, online information about federal grants, contracts, earmarks, loans, and lobbyist contacts with government officials.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"In Barack Obama's Administration, the administration will make government data available online.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"In Barack Obama's Administration, the administration will have an online video archive of significant agency meetings.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"In Barack Obama's Administration, the administration will put all non-emergency bills that Congress has passed online for five days to allow the American public to review and comment on them before they are signed into law.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"In Barack Obama's Administration, the administration will require Cabinet officials to have periodic national online town hall meetings to discuss issues before their agencies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
